ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The attached figure is titled "Top elevation distribution map of a certain shale layer at each drilling well"; in the figure there are multiple black dots representing drilling well locations, and elevation values such as 340, 342, 303, 348 are marked beside the black dots; within the figure there are also multiple curved contour lines, marked with 450, 500, 550, etc.; overall it shows the spatial distribution of the top elevation of a certain shale layer, indicating that the question background is indeed related to shale layer resources. Then reason: The question-stem material states that shale gas is natural gas extracted from shale layers, and that it is an important unconventional natural gas resource. According to the classification of mineral energy sources in textbooks, unconventional natural gas resources are usually classified as new energy among mineral energy sources. Therefore, shale gas belongs to new energy among mineral energy sources.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像，确认附图表现的是多个钻井和页岩层顶部高程等值线，题目背景确实是页岩层资源。再读文字材料，抓住“页岩气是从页岩层中开采出来的天然气”“重要的非常规天然气资源”。据教材分类，把非常规天然气资源归为矿物能源中的新能源，因此作答“新能源”。
